subject: The 2AM confession that changed everything
preview_text: I was up late, frustrated, and made a decision that became the app's most important feature. Here's why.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM and I was staring at my phone, reading the same text thread for the tenth time. A friend was stuck in a cycle of 'sorry' and 'I promise' from someone who kept hurting them. I felt that familiar, helpless anger. I knew the patterns were there, but pointing them out felt like overstepping. That's when I realized the real problem.

We all have that gut feeling. That twist in your stomach when a 'joke' isn't funny, or when an apology feels like a trap. But we doubt ourselves. We think, 'Maybe I'm overreacting.' I built this app because I was tired of watching people I care about talk themselves out of their own intuition. That night, I decided the AI shouldn't just list red flags—it had to validate the user's gut feeling first. To say, 'You're not crazy for feeling this way.'

That 2AM frustration is why the 'Toxicity Score & Breakdown' exists. It's not just a number. It's a mirror. It takes those vague, anxious feelings and gives them a shape—showing you the exact patterns of gaslighting, love bombing, or manipulation hidden in plain text. It was built to be the objective voice you need when your own head is too loud.

Open the app right now and scan just one conversation. Don't overthink it. Pick the one that's been bothering you, even a little. Let the breakdown show you what you might be missing. P.S. The first user who tested this feature at 3AM texted me: 'I finally saw what my friends couldn't say.' That's the moment I knew it worked.
